title: PreferenceClaim payload
description: What a candidate said they want next (from a call). One claim per facet; a newer one replaces the older. must = won't consider anything else; prefer = would rather. Never personality, culture or fit.

min.description: company_size: at least this many people

max.description: company_size: at most this many people

want.description: employer kinds (startup, scaleup, large, consultancy, agency, public_sector, non_profit), settings (onsite, hybrid, remote), places (ISO country codes), role families, or employment (permanent, contract)

level.description: work: the level they want next
